modules.title: Introduction to Aropo Orukọ (Pronouns)
modules.html:
Personal and possessive pronouns in Yoruba. This section covers introduction to aropo orukọ (pronouns).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of aropo orukọ (pronouns).
  • Be able to explain aropo orukọ (pronouns) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Irúfẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-asojú-orúkọ wo ni 'Èmi'?
A: Adáńdúró — 'Èmi' is an independent (emphatic) pronoun used to refer to the speaker in the first person singular.

Q: Parí òwe yìí: 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, _____ m' bẹ'.
A: Ìtura — The proverb 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, ìtura m' bẹ' implies that as long as there is life, there is hope for comfort/relief.

examples.q: Parí òwe yìí: 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, _____ m' bẹ'.

quiz.q: Irúfẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-asojú-orúkọ wo ni 'Èmi'?
quiz.solution: 'Èmi' is an independent (emphatic) pronoun used to refer to the speaker in the first person singular.

quiz.q: Parí òwe yìí: 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, _____ m' bẹ'.
quiz.solution: The proverb 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, ìtura m' bẹ' implies that as long as there is life, there is hope for comfort/relief.

quiz.q: Kí ni orúkọ àmì ohùn orí 'i' nínú ọ̀rọ̀ 'mì'?
quiz.solution: The low tone marks (`) are called Àmì-ìsàlẹ̀ or Àmì-dò.

quiz.q: Nínú 'Ogboju Ode', ta ni a mọ̀ sí 'ẹni tí ó ní ìyá méjì'?
quiz.solution: This refers to the protagonist Akara-oogun in Fagunwa's literature.

quiz.q: Parí òwe yìí: 'Iṣẹ́ ni oògùn _____'?
quiz.solution: The proverb 'Iṣẹ́ ni oògùn ìyà' means work is the antidote to poverty/suffering.

quiz.q: Kí ni orúkọ Yorùbá fún 'Market'?
quiz.solution: 'Ọjà' is a market.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ fáwẹ́lì àránmú 'un'?
quiz.solution: 'un' is a high back nasal vowel.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Verb' ní èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀ Ìṣe.

quiz.q: Iṣẹ́ wo ni a fi 'Ọkọ́' ṣe?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Iṣẹ́ Àgbẹ̀.

quiz.q: Oúnjẹ Ìbejì ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ẹ̀wà.

quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ẹ.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Mother'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ìyá.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Sleep'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Sùn.

quiz.q: Nínú ìgbéyàwó, kí ni 'Idana'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Introduction/Engagement.

quiz.q: Ta ni ó máa ń gbé 'Opá Aṣẹ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ọba.

quiz.q: Ménu ba oríṣìí èdè tí a fi ń kọ ewì alohùn?

quiz.q: Nínú gírámà Yorùbá, kí ni iṣẹ́ 'ọ̀rọ̀-orúkọ'?
options: Láti dárúkọ ènìyàn, ẹranko, tàbí nǹkan
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Láti dárúkọ ènìyàn, ẹranko, tàbí nǹkan.

quiz.q: Kí ni a ń pè ní 'Àlọ́ Àpamọ̀'?

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ yìí: 'Aṣọ'?

quiz.q: Ta ni ó máa ń jẹ́ 'Ọba' ní ìlú?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Aláṣẹ èkejì òrìṣà.

quiz.q: Èwo ni 'Ìyá' nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mother.

quiz.q: Fáwẹ̀lì èdè Yorùbá pín sí ọ̀nà mélòó?

quiz.q: Ta ni baba ńlá àwọn Yorùbá?

quiz.q: Èwo ni kì í ṣe oúnjẹ Yorùbá?

Gbólóhùn wo ni 'Ọmọ náà lọ sí ilé-ìwé' — Gbólóhùn àsọyé.
Ìtàn 'Sùúrù lérè' kọ́ wa ní... — Ìwà sùúrù.
Aṣọ wo ni wọ́n máa ń lò fún òkú sínsìn láyé àtijọ́ — Aṣọ funfun.
quiz.solution: Ta ni baba ńlá àwọn Yorùbá — Odùduwà.

quiz.q: Which of the following is true about Aropo Orukọ (Pronouns) — 'remi'?
options: Kí ni orúkọ baba Ṣàngó — Ọ̀ráńyàn.
Mọ́remí Àjàṣorò jẹ́ akọni obìnrin ní ìlú: — Ilé-Ifẹ̀.
Aṣọ wo ni wọ́n máa ń lò fún òkú sínsìn láyé àtijọ́ — Aṣọ funfun.
Ìtàn 'Sùúrù lérè' kọ́ wa ní... — Ìwà sùúrù.
quiz.solution: Mọ́remí Àjàṣorò jẹ́ akọni obìnrin ní ìlú: — Ilé-Ifẹ̀.

quiz.q: About 'ada', which of the following is true in Aropo Orukọ (Pronouns)?
options: Òrìṣà tí ó fẹ́ràn ìgbín ni: — Ọbàtálá.
Èwo ni àpẹẹrẹ ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe nínú gbólóhùn yìí: 'Olú jẹ ìyán' — jẹ.
quiz.solution: Irúfẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-asojú-orúkọ wo ni 'Èmi' — Adáńdúró.

quiz.q: About 'tura', which of the following is true in Aropo Orukọ (Pronouns)?
options: Òrìṣà tí ó fẹ́ràn ìgbín ni: — Ọbàtálá.
Èwo ni àpẹẹrẹ ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe nínú gbólóhùn yìí: 'Olú jẹ ìyán' — jẹ.
Parí òwe yìí: 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, _____ m' bẹ'. — Ìtura.
quiz.solution: Parí òwe yìí: 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, _____ m' bẹ'. — Ìtura.
